about: ASoftware setup: what every installer (PC: Install-ASoftware.ps1, ios26/Install-iOS26.ps1, watchos/Install-watchOS.ps1, Setup-ASoftware.ps1; phone: the Android app's own setup) downloads from Apple and which steps it runs. Draft 2026-11-08 by the phone-setup session, filled from the scripts in ios-sweet-watch (branch watchos-installer) and from the IPSWs' own central directories (crc32, zipBytes, method). bytes = the member's size once unpacked (what the installers pin today); zipBytes = its size inside the zip when deflated (method 8). GB = 10^9.

helper.machine: -M virt -cpu cortex-a76 -m 4G, virtio-blk disks found by serial

jobs.build-root: disks ipsw (ro), root (16 GiB), scratch (10 GiB qcow2): iOS 16's root disk from its IPSW
jobs.run: disks in (tar: .job/run, .job/disks, .job/out), out (the result as a tar), and the job's own: the iOS 26 / watchOS installers' Linux steps

ios16.title: iOS 16.7.16 (iPhone X)

ipsw.note: The PC downloads the whole IPSW (curl, SHA-256); the phone fetches only these members into a sparse copy of the IPSW (same offsets, plus the central directory), which job-build-root.sh and ipsw-devicetree.py read unchanged. ipsw-members.py takes OS/SystemOS/AppOS from BuildManifest's first D22* Erase identity (d221ap; the same images as d22ap).

kernel.note: our XNU build: in the PC package and the app
